versions.localizedDescription:
Disk stats now hide removable volumes by default, matching Exelban Stats' default behavior. The iPhone Disk screen has a settings button to show them when wanted.

## What's Changed

### Improvements and Fixes

- Classify mounted volumes using macOS Disk Arbitration, including disk images and removable drives.
- Add a persistent “Show removable disks” option in the iPhone Disk Settings sheet.
- Keep existing pairings and older disk snapshots compatible.

## Download

- **Mac companion · 0.3.10:** `StatsCompanion-v0.3.10-macOS-universal.dmg` for Finder installation, or the signed universal ZIP for in-menu updates.
- **iPhone app · 0.3.8:** `Stats-v0.3.8-iOS.ipa` (iOS 17+, arm64; unsigned for SideStore and AltStore).
- Install both updates to use the removable-volume setting. See the [README](https://github.com/ishtiaq156/stats#quick-start) for installation and pairing.

**Full Changelog:** https://github.com/ishtiaq156/stats/compare/v0.3.13...v0.3.14
